title: Amortizing Sequential Experimental Design in Reasoning LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.20832v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Despite their extensive pretraining knowledge and strong reasoning capabilities, large language models (LLMs) struggle to adaptively gather information in experimental design tasks. We study how to amortize sequential Bayesian experimental design (BED) into an LLM by explicitly training the reasoning that guides action selection using information-gain rewards. Our approach specifies the experimental generative model independently of the LLM's own beliefs, allowing us to optimize expected information gain under a model of our choosing. We investigate the design choices for amortization, including alternative generative-model constructions, reward estimation, hypothesis-space specification, multi-step objectives, and computational costs relative to training- and inference-time BED baselines. translated_title: 在推理大语言模型中摊销序贯实验设计
translated_abstract: 尽管大语言模型（LLM）拥有广泛的预训练知识和强大的推理能力，但它们在实验设计任务中难以自适应地收集信息。我们研究了如何通过使用信息增益奖励显式训练引导动作选择的推理过程，将序贯贝叶斯实验设计（BED）摊销到LLM中。我们的方法独立于LLM自身的信念来指定实验生成模型，使我们能够在所选模型下优化期望信息增益。我们研究了摊销过程中的各项设计选择，包括不同的生成模型构建方式、奖励估计、假设空间规范、多步目标，以及相对于训练时和推理时BED基线的计算成本。在“二十个问题”任务上，所得策略改善了信息获取和任务表现，优于推理时和训练时的BED基线。
tldr: 该论文通过以信息增益奖励显式训练LLM的推理过程，将序贯贝叶斯实验设计摊销到LLM中，使其在实验设计任务中能够自适应地收集信息，并在二十个问题任务上超越了训练时和推理时的BED基线方法。
en_tdlr: This paper amortizes sequential Bayesian experimental design into reasoning LLMs by explicitly training the reasoning that guides action selection with information-gain rewards, enabling adaptive information acquisition that outperforms both inference-time and training-time BED baselines on Twenty Questions.
